figures.caption: Fig. 1: Suppression vs. Quality Corruption. Same image, same PGD (ε=8/255). (a) Clean: five correct detections. (b) ANN baseline (YOLOv3-tiny): all detections vanish. (c) Hardware-deployable SNN (EMS-YOLO): five detections remain, none correct. A count-based monitor reports normal operation in both (a) and (c).
Table 2: Quality Corruption: EMSYOLO retains detections while accuracy collapses. EMS-YOLO under ℓ∞ and ℓ2 PGD; ANN and non-deployable models for contrast. All results: 10 steps, 1,000 images.

Table 1: Four SNN detectors classified by hardware deployability. Constraints from Sec. 2: (i) binary spikes, (ii) AC-only, (iii) no dense matmul. Only EMS-YOLO satisfies all three. Non-deployable models vary encoding, neuron type, and temporal depth, providing controlled variation for Sec. 4.
